- Baseline behavior of the starting weights (512 cached answers, select): 49.0% acc; dominant failure = non-termination, 28.1% cut at 8,192 tokens, concentrated by difficulty (L1 .81, L2 .81, L3 .56, L4 .43, L5 .11 with 77% truncated).
